messages.subject: Penalized logistics - post estimation
parts:
Hello - I am using the Penalized and GLMNET packages in R to estimate L-1 penalized logistics regressions. Both packages give me the subset of variables and their coefficients based on chosen level of penalty (Lamba 1). 

(a) Any ideas how to get the p-values / SE of these coefficients? Conceptually, does it make sense to interpret the p-values in the same way as a regular logistics regression (say one using the GLM package)?

(b) How do I use the chosen variables and coefficients to calculate marginal effects? Currently, when I do a regular logistics, I use the MFX package to estimate odds ratio and marginal effects. How does one do this following a penalized regression? Again - conceptually, does it make sense to calculate ME after a penalized regression? 

If anyone has done any of the above post-estimation, I will greatly appreciate if you can share your code. 

Thanks.

parts:
Sure - look here.

http://statweb.stanford.edu/~tibs/ftp/covtest.pdf

The associated package is covTest.

Matt
